title: Cinematic production brief
description: Portable formatVersion 3 shot-list handoff for a cinematic sequence. Markdown is the human twin; this JSON is the runtime contract for downstream Unreal/Godot importers. Engine-native .tres/.uasset files are adapters after this schema gate, not the source of truth.

$schema.title: Schema URI
$schema.description: Optional JSON Schema identifier stamped on generated briefs so importers can locate this 2020-12 contract.

formatVersion.title: Format version
formatVersion.description: Handoff artifact discriminator. Version 3 makes camera a structured object (shotSize, lensMm, fovDeg, move, notes). Importers must reject any other value.

title.title: Sequence title
title.description: Human-readable name of the sequence this brief was generated from.

description.title: Sequence description
description.description: Optional synopsis of the sequence. Empty string when the source board has no description.

totalShots.title: Total shots
totalShots.description: Count of shots in playback order. Must equal shots.length.

totalDuration.title: Total duration
totalDuration.description: Rolled-up duration estimate across shots (for example '21-32s') or 'Unknown' when no shot carries a parsable duration.

shots.title: Shots
shots.description: Shot list in cinematic flow order (graph topology), not authoring-array order. Each entry is one producible beat.

connections.title: Sequence connections
connections.description: Directed edit-flow edges between shots (sequence, match cut, reaction, and other cinematic connection types). Raw enum values; humanize only in Markdown.

readySummary.title: Readiness summary
readySummary.description: Counts of shots at each production-readiness level. The four counts must sum to totalShots.

productionBriefShot.title: Production brief shot
productionBriefShot.description: One shot in the portable handoff. Nullables are omitted production fields, not missing keys; arrays are always present (empty when unused).

frameId.title: Frame id
frameId.description: Stable id of the source storyboard frame this shot was generated from.

title.title: Shot title
title.description: Short slate name for the shot list (for example 'Hook Shot').

type.title: Frame type
type.description: Cinematic frame type enum as stored on the board (shot, camera_move, dialogue, vfx, …). JSON keeps the raw key; Markdown humanizes it.

intent.title: Intent
intent.description: One implementable purpose for the shot, or null when unspecified.

visualDescription.title: Visual description
visualDescription.description: What is on screen — subject, light, and action — or null when unspecified.

camera.title: Camera
camera.description: Structured Sequencer camera (shotSize, lensMm, fovDeg, move) plus optional free-text notes. Null when unspecified. arc is the orbit/arc moving-camera token. Not a 35° sprite-turnaround orbit; no azimuth/turnaround fields.

fovDeg.title: Field of view
fovDeg.description: Horizontal field of view in degrees.

move.title: Camera move
move.description: Sequencer move token. arc covers orbit/arc shots.

notes.title: Author notes
notes.description: Free-text cameraAngle / cameraMovement copy. Not used to classify complexity.

framing.title: Framing
framing.description: Composition notes (thirds, headroom, eyeline) or null when unspecified.

duration.title: Duration
duration.description: Shot duration estimate as authored (for example '3-5s') or null when unspecified.

dialogue.title: Dialogue
dialogue.description: Spoken lines and VO cues for this shot. Empty array when the shot has no dialogue.

items.title: Dialogue line
items.description: One spoken or VO line, including speaker attribution when known.

actionNotes.title: Action notes
actionNotes.description: Blocking and on-screen action beats. Empty array when unused.

items.title: Action note
items.description: One blocking or action instruction for performers or animation.

continuity.title: Continuity requirements
continuity.description: Spatial, wardrobe, eyeline, and weather matches this shot must keep. Empty array when unused.

items.title: Continuity requirement
items.description: One match that must hold across the cut into or out of this shot.

requiredAssets.title: Required assets
requiredAssets.description: Sets, characters, renders, captures, and graphics this shot consumes. Empty array when unused.

items.title: Required asset
items.description: One named asset a producer can put on a pull list.

vfx.title: VFX requirements
vfx.description: Compositing, simulation, and motion-graphics needs. Empty array when unused.

items.title: VFX requirement
items.description: One visual-effects deliverable for this shot.

audio.title: Audio requirements
audio.description: Dialogue VO, score, foley, and SFX needs. Empty array when unused.

items.title: Audio requirement
items.description: One audio deliverable for this shot.

editNotes.title: Edit notes
editNotes.description: Cut points, pacing, and transition instructions, or null when unspecified.

checklist.title: Implementation checklist
checklist.description: Producer/implementer tasks that close this shot. Empty array when unused.

items.title: Checklist item
items.description: One concrete task that must be done before the shot is production-ready.

testCriteria.title: Test criteria
testCriteria.description: Acceptance checks for the finished shot. Empty array when unused.

items.title: Test criterion
items.description: One observable pass/fail check for dailies or an edit review.

status.title: Readiness status
status.description: Beat-status level for this shot. JSON keeps the raw enum; Markdown humanizes ready as SPEC.

missingReasons.title: Missing reasons
missingReasons.description: Beat-status reason codes when the shot is not ready (for example no_visualDescription). Omitted on ready shots so the payload stays quiet.

items.title: Missing reason code
items.description: Machine reason code from getCinematicBeatStatus; Markdown humanizes it.

productionBriefConnection.title: Production brief connection
productionBriefConnection.description: One directed edit-flow edge. Titles are denormalized from the source frames so importers can render a shot list without a second lookup.

id.title: Connection id
id.description: Stable id of the source storyboard connection.

fromTitle.title: From title
fromTitle.description: Title of the outgoing shot, or the frame id when the title is missing.

toTitle.title: To title
toTitle.description: Title of the incoming shot, or the frame id when the title is missing.

type.title: Connection type
type.description: Raw cinematic connection enum (sequence, match_cut, cutaway, reaction, transition, continuity, parallel_action, fallback). Markdown humanizes it.

readySummary.title: Readiness summary
readySummary.description: Per-level shot counts from getCinematicBeatStatus. Keys match CinematicBeatStatusLevel.

ready.title: Ready count
ready.description: Number of shots at ready (SPEC) — spec score ≥ 3 and no type blocker.

partial.title: Partial count
partial.description: Number of shots with some spec but not yet ready.

draft.title: Draft count
draft.description: Number of shots with no spec and no type blocker.

blocked.title: Blocked count
blocked.description: Number of shots missing a type-required field.
